The Sanctum's door opens from an outdoor spot that these files don't tie to a hold or landmark.

Malfyur is placed in the Winking Skeever and has two half-day routines whose places aren't decoded here. Alara also says he has been defiling bodies in the Hall of the Dead, so he may not be at the inn when you arrive.
No reward is on the quest's script; the journal says only that Alara will speak to you when you're ready, which leads into Our Lady.
